newsitem.title: USA: CCC BUYS U.S. HRW WHEAT FOR ARMENIA AND GEORGIA.
newsitem.headline: CCC BUYS U.S. HRW WHEAT FOR ARMENIA AND GEORGIA.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corp said it bought 6,500 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Armenia and 6,500 tonnes of U.S. HRW wheat for donation to Georgia.
The two 6,500-tonne shipments were bought from Continental Grain at $148.17, FOB, Beaumont, Texas, the CCC said, which is part of the U.S. Department of Agriculture.

Armenia also bought 1,134 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better HRW wheat in bulk under the PL-480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said. That wheat was 12 percent protein at $148.49 a tonne, FOB, Beaumont, the agent said.
The delivery dates were also August 20 to September 8.
